messages:
Alex (AE): Kicking off sync for ACME POC — need to lock tenant isolation approach and a realistic token/throughput estimate. Customer target start: Mon 4/10. They listed ~400k tokens/day in their brief but said spikes possible.
Priya (SE): Confirm use case: chat summarization + RAG. Embeddings handled in their vector DB (not using Redwood embeddings). We'll run a small eval set of their 20 prompts.
Sam (Infra): For strict tenant isolation they asked for VPC + dedicated pool. That pushes toward Dedicated or Private deployment. Need to agree on GPU class (A10G vs A100) and autoscale policy.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Quick back-of-envelope: if peak is 10 r/s and avg 3k tokens/req -> 30k tokens/s -> 108M tokens/hr -> 864M tokens for 8hr day. That obviously exceeds their written 400k/day. We need to reconcile expected per-request token size or cap throughput for POC.
Mei (Customer SA): They expect repeated prompts (templates) so caching will help. Their PM suggests effective tokens ~30% lower during POC. Also PII redaction requirement in security questionnaire — they'll need KMS + audit logs.
Priya (SE): Plan: run token simulator with their 20 prompts + synthetic variance. Assume caching reduces token cost 30-50% depending on overlap. Also propose quantized model variant (q4_0/q8_0) for the POC to reduce GPU memory and cost.
Sam (Infra): Minimal Dedicated config I recommend for the POC:
```yaml
dedicated_pool:
  gpu: a10g
  workers: 2
  autoscale_min: 1
  autoscale_max: 2
  batch_ms: 128
  kv_cache_ttl_s: 300
``` 
This should hit latency SLO ~200-350ms/token for the q4_0 variant with batching.
Jordan (Sales Eng): Budget check: customer has $6k for a 2-week POC. Rough cost estimates:
- Hosted trial (with q4_0): ~ $2.8k for 2 weeks at capped throughput (3 r/s)
- Dedicated mini-pool (reserved short-term) estimate: ~$4.2k for 2 weeks (includes reserved GPU hours + infra overhead)
If we need full 10 r/s sustained, cost jumps >$12k for 2 weeks.
Alex (AE): Given $6k cap, suggest proposing a hosted POC with VPC egress controls, q4_0 model, throughput cap at 3 r/s and enforced KV caching — shows capability without blowing budget.
Mei (Customer SA): Security items to include in answers: data residency (US-only), KMS integration (bring-your-own), audit log retention 90d, SOC2 details. I'll assemble the answers and drop the questionnaire link here.
Priya (SE): I'll run offline eval by EOD with three scenarios: (1) conservative tokens (400k/day), (2) cached tokens (30% reduction), (3) peak short bursts (10 r/s). Will post simulator results and token-cost curves.
Sam (Infra): Action item: I'll prepare a minimal Dedicated config + cost table and a hosted-cap cap config with throttling rules and burst policy. Will include estimate for autoscale to 2 workers during bursts.
deploy-bot: Ticket created #P-1234: sales/poc/tenant-isolation — infra owner assigned Sam.
Jordan (Sales Eng): I'll draft SOW options (hosted-capped vs Dedicated mini-pool) and include clear success criteria: 1) avg latency <400ms token, 2) 20 prompt eval pass-rate >=90% on quality gates, 3) infra within $6k budget for 2 weeks.
Alex (AE): Great. Next steps: Priya to post simulator numbers, Sam to post cost table, Jordan to attach SOW draft. 9am sync tomorrow to finalize proposal. :thumbsup:
